## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmers: weak sector breadth and narrow leadership concentration in Technology (Top 5 performers all Tech), while defensives are not leading.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing pockets of strength: MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary: TSLA (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +23.94%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +4.39% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; no major mega-cap divergence among MSFT/AAPL/NVDA — only minor divergences such as SLB (TREND EXHAUSTION) and MO (TREND EXHAUSTION).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology shows concentrated strength (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99%) led by semiconductors and equipment; AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND. Watch narrow leadership and potential rotation if breadth fades.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials under pressure (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%); JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sector breadth negative and not confirming risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare weakening (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -4.63%); UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND — defensive bid absent overall.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Operate with caution and be selective: favor participation in clearly ABOVE TREND momentum names (e.g., AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to late-cycle Energy and weak Financials such as XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND and PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND on AI-fab order flow; AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND on negative sentiment; XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND for energy pullback.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99%) if chip/equipment leaders hold gains. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.04% | 1M: -1.38%) and Financials (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%) for continued downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND for breakout follow-through above recent highs and loss of momentum on weekly reversal. Monitor AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND for support on pullbacks and JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND for breakdown below recent 1W lows as a wider risk signal.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
PYPL (-50): PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price are aligned, increasing downside risk. (Limited cross-over: several negative headlines such as NOW (-60) and RCL (-55) are notable but lack dual-timeframe data here.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and leadership is narrowly concentrated in Technology. AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while Energy/Financial names such as XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND and PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND are key risks to monitor.
